name: Envech by Queen Bees - Gameable 2023
author: game_able
description: The goal is to pick up trash from the Earth and make the world green again. Our Player has the capabilities to go right left and jump. To accomplish these mouvements, they must use the arrow keys. The environnement of our world starts as a messy and degraded planet earth. As you pick up trash, the environnement becomes greener and greener.
